acceptanceCriteria: Ticket show, plan preview and queue status expose retry charged/limit/remaining for the current acceptance revision using the admission predicate.
Reason breakdown retains explicit uncertainty for unavailable legacy generation history and never invents historical reasons.
Zero-limit, clean handoff, exhausted debt and acceptance revision tests pass with independent review and linked immutable evidence.
body:
## Problem

An agent can't see how much of a ticket's retry budget is used until a claim is refused with `RETRY_EXHAUSTED`.

On `main-c4de689`, `ticket show <id>` returns `currentAttempt`, `eligibility` and `nextAction` but no retry accounting. Neither does `plan preview`. Per-attempt `retryCount` is only visible through `attempt show` on a known attempt ID, and that is lost once the attempt ends. Now that `retries.admissionsPerRevision` is configurable (#420), operators also need to see how close each ticket is to its limit.

## Request

Show retry accounting on `ticket show`, and summarise it in `plan preview`/`queue status`:

- `retries: {charged, limit, remaining, byReason: {EXPIRED, RELEASED, FAILED, ...}}` for the current acceptance revision.

This would let coordinators prefer hand-off releases for nearly exhausted tickets, and raise an alert before exhaustion rather than after.


Source: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/427
Baseline: official Tasks build 202 and source cf4c8a39e171d72374e8baadeb744d4105116eda. Reproductions retained under /tmp/corvint-426-428 and /tmp/corvint-428-repro-policy-show.json; holder state currently has no heartbeat fields; policy show returns ERROR; retry projections absent.
title: corvint-tasks: retry accounting is not visible on ticket show or plan preview
